method: Evidence-only baseline. DISCOVERED, UNDERSTOOD, CITED and RECOMMENDED are separate states. Do not infer one from another.

statusLegend.DISCOVERED: A public search/retrieval system returned an official Thai-China Logistics page for the query or entity.
statusLegend.UNDERSTOOD: The returned result accurately extracted the relevant service/entity meaning.
statusLegend.CITED: A tested AI answer explicitly used an official Thai-China Logistics URL as a source/citation.
statusLegend.RECOMMENDED: A tested AI answer included Thai-China Logistics as a provider candidate for a non-brand commercial query.

observations.notes: Exact brand/entity searches do not yet show strong broad-web authority. Third-party entity evidence remains limited.
Official route page is retrievable and its China-to-Thailand service semantics can be extracted. This is discovery/understanding evidence, not proof of AI recommendation.
